content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: BRIC-THSTI is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council (BRIC), under the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. It works on fundamental, clinical and implementation research, and its notice lists centres such as the Centre for Maternal and Child Health, the Centre for Virus Research, Therapeutics and Vaccines and the Centre for Tuberculosis Research. It has also set up a Medical Research Centre (MRC) and is operationalising the APEX Centre, a 100,000+ sq ft pre-product-development facility. This recruitment fills vacancies under the projects named below.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To conduct and coordinate preclinical evaluation of a novel dengue antiviral compound, including in-vitro antiviral assays, molecular analyses, efficacy and safety assessment in approved animal models, evaluation of optimized derivatives, data analysis, scientific documentation, and preparation of reports and publications, in compliance with institutional biosafety and regulatory requirements. To assist in cell culture, sample processing and storage, molecular biology assays, in-vitro antiviral experiments, preparation of reagents, maintenance of laboratory records and equipment. Experience in conducting/ handling pre-clinical animal studies, expert in cell culture, performing immunological assays, FACS, cell sorting etc., data analysis and report writing. Hands-on experience in laboratory animal handling, particularly mice, for research experiments. Practical experience in Mammalian Cell Culture Techniques. Working knowledge of molecular biology techniques, including DNA isolation, PCR, agarose gel electrophoresis, and cloning. Practical knowledge of protein analysis techniques, including SDS-PAGE and Western blotting. Experience in the preparation of laboratory buffers, reagents, and solutions. Good laboratory practices, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a research team. Experience in the development of new immunoassays for clinical use, recombinant protein production from mammalian cells, high throughput liquid handling (immunoassays). Preparation of culture media and buffers, agarose gel electrophoresis, SDS-PAGE. Experience in a hospital/clinical laboratory or field study: collecting and handling respiratory swabs and blood samples, specimen processing and cold-chain transport, participant enrolment, consent and data entry. Experience in collecting nasopharyngeal or oropharyngeal swabs and blood samples, obtaining participant consent, sample handling and transport under biosafety precautions, and record keeping. Assist the Principal Investigator and Biostatistician in carrying out data analysis-related activities. Preparing the dataset for statistical analysis. Exploratory data analysis and data visualization, preparing manuscript-ready figures and tables. Data management: manage, clean, and preprocess pooled datasets from diverse sources, ensuring data integrity and consistency. Develop and maintain detailed documentation for data management processes, including data cleaning, merging, and variable creation. Data analysis: conduct statistical analyses on pooled datasets using appropriate statistical software and apply various statistical methods. Ensure the application of rigorous data validation and quality control measures throughout the analysis process. Administrative and documentation support: support in routine administrative, reporting, and documentation-related work as assigned. content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates walk in for a written test, skill test or interview at 9:00 am on the date against their post. Candidates coming after the time slot mentioned will not be entertained. If many candidates appear, screening will be done to limit the number to those possessing higher or relevant qualification and experience. Everyone coming to THSTI for the test or interview must deposit their mobile phone with a valid ID at the reception; both are returned only on completion of the entire selection process.

faq.question: Q1. When are the BRIC-THSTI walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: They are on 2, 3, 4, 8, 10 and 15 December 2026, depending on the post. For example, S.No. 1 and 2 are on 2 December, S.No. 5 and 6 on 15 December.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting is at 9:00 am. S.No. 1 to 14 report at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001; S.No. 15 and 16 report at Room No. 366C, Child Development Centre, Third Floor, OPD Building, Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi-110029.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 18 posts: 16 listed rows, of which S.No. 12 (Project Technical Support-III) and S.No. 13 (Project Nurse-I) have two posts each.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist-II?
faq.answer: A Post-Graduate degree in Life Sciences with at least 3 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field, or a Ph.D. (awarded) in Life Sciences. S.No. 5 also needs at least one first-author peer-reviewed publication in a recognized journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It is 40 years for Project Research Scientist-II, 45 for Project Research Scientist-III, 25 for Project Nurse-I and 35 for the other posts. The date of interview of the respective post is the crucial date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Monthly consolidated emoluments are Rs. 18,000/- (Project Nurse-I) to Rs. 78,000/- (Project Research Scientist-III). Project Research Scientist-II is Rs. 67,000/-, Project Research Scientist-I Rs. 56,000/-, Project Assistant Rs. 35,000/-, and Project Technical Support-III and Project Nurse-III Rs. 28,000/- each.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: "Plus HRA" is printed against the pay of every post except Project Assistant. For Project Assistant the notice prints Rs. 35,000/- without HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring your latest CV/resume, one set of self-attested photocopies of documents supporting qualification and experience, the originals, and a valid ID card. Mobile phones must be deposited at the THSTI reception.

faq.question: Q9. How is selection done?
faq.answer: Candidates walk in for a written test, skill test or interview on their date. If many appear, screening limits the number to those with higher or relevant qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, the notice calls them short-term positions. Extension depends on satisfactory performance and the project tenure, and appointees have no claim for regularization.
